How the App Saves Your Time:
During the Day (Zero Re-Logins):

Once connected in the morning, your token is securely saved in fyersConfig.json.
If you refresh your browser, close the tab, or restart your computer during the trading day, you do NOT need to re-enter anything — the app auto-connects automatically.
Next Morning Routine (Takes only 10 Seconds): Each morning before market opens (around 09:00 AM):

Click Connect Fyers in the top navigation bar.
Click Open Fyers Login Page (logs in with your Fyers PIN / OTP).
Copy the auth_code= from the address bar and paste it into the Auth Code box.
Click Connect Fyers Account.
The app automatically generates the SHA-256 hash, retrieves your new Access Token, and keeps your live stream active for the entire trading day (09:15 AM to 03:40 PM IST).
